column1: # provenance: join of the two files above, by spike sp-kz6ml. A gate row is matched to the
# testenv-batch run whose suite timestamps fall inside [gate_end - ran, gate_end]. Rows with
# ran<30s and rows with no contained batch are omitted: batch-results directories are keyed by
# a content hash and are OVERWRITTEN by a later run with the same key, so early-hour batches are
# under-represented. This is a bias toward MISSING rows, not toward wrong ones.
